slides.heading: You paid for that enquiry. Here are 7 places it goes cold.
slides.body: Most of them happen after the lead lands. Most have a free fix.

slides.heading: Only about 37% answered web leads within an hour
slides.body: An audit of 2,241 US firms. 23% never answered at all. No comparable India study found, so I'm running my own small tests.
slides.source: BYU ScholarsArchive / HBR, "The Short Life of Online Sales Leads" (2011). US data.

slides.heading: After-hours enquiries
slides.body: A Meta-ad lead lands at 10:42 pm. You see it after breakfast. Free fix tonight: a WhatsApp Business away message that thanks them and asks one question.

slides.heading: Portal leads that never reach WhatsApp
slides.body: 99acres, MagicBricks or Housing.com alerts sit under OTP emails. You paid for that lead. Free fix: a Gmail filter that stars every portal alert.

slides.heading: Instagram DMs stuck in Message requests
slides.body: "Price?" is a raised hand. Three days later, they've forgotten your listing. Free fix: check Message requests every evening.

slides.heading: Four more leaks, after the first reply
slides.body: Each one has a free fix in the kit, using the WhatsApp Business app.

carousels.title: Meta's free WhatsApp AI vs what you actually need

slides.heading: Meta's WhatsApp AI is free now. Do you still need me?
slides.body: Honest answer: maybe not. Here's how to tell.

slides.heading: Meta launched Business AI on WhatsApp for Indian businesses
slides.body: Business AI arrived in May 2026, Meta Business Agent in July. They answer customers for you, around the clock. Basic FAQ bots are now close to free.
slides.source: Deccan Herald; UNI (2026). Features change often: check your app.

slides.heading: Mostly FAQs? Use Meta's free AI.
slides.body: Timings, location, price list, "is it available?". One number, one person replying, leads from one place. Set it up yourself and keep your money.

slides.heading: Free AI in the app vs a connected lead system

right.label: What you still connect
items: Routing: hot lead to the right agent
One log in your Sheet or CRM

slides.source: Based on Meta's announced features, Oct 2026. Check your app.

slides.heading: 4 questions that decide it
items: Does more than one person reply?
Do leads go quiet after day 2?
Do you know last month's lead count?
slides.body: Mostly no: use the free AI. Mostly yes (or no count at all): you need the connected system.

slides.heading: General-purpose AI chatbots are banned on WhatsApp's business platform
slides.body: Bots must be scoped to your business: enquiries, bookings, support. So "ChatGPT on WhatsApp" is out. Every assistant I build answers only about your business.

slides.heading: I use Meta's free tools where they fit, then connect the rest
slides.body: Your accounts, your number. I connect lead sources, the qualifier, handover, booking and 30-day follow-up. Solo Sprint: ₹34,999 / $1,499, excl. GST.

slides.heading: Comment LEAKS for the free Lead Leak Kit
slides.body: It has a "free tools first" page: set up Meta's free options before you pay anyone, me included. Check your message requests.
